blurb: Bensfort Bridge Resort is located on the Otonabee River, part of the Trent Severn Waterway, 12km from Rice Lake, 8km from Peterborough, and 145km from Toronto. It became popular as a fishing camp in the late 1940's. Bensfort Bridge Resort offers a variety of camping choices. Cottages, fully serviced 30-amp seasonal sites, boat docks up to 22 feet and boat launch.
